info.title: Business Pages
info.description: Endpoints to read and change the public business page of a business: its About section and theme, its action buttons and its footer links. Available for **Staff tokens**. Business details that the page shows, such as the name, the phone number and whether contact details are public, belong to the business and are not part of this API.

get.description: Returns the business page of the business in the token. The list has one item. If the business has no page yet, the page is created from its legacy LiveSite settings first. Available for **Staff tokens**. The staff member must be the business owner or have the online presence permission.

success.description: Always false for an error response (e.g., false)

errors.description: The errors that stopped the request, one item for each error

field.description: Name of the request field that the error is about, when there is one (e.g., "background_color")

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the error (e.g., "must be a 6-digit hex colour")

about_title.description: Title of the About section, up to 150 characters (e.g., "About our studio" or null).

about_summary.description: Short About text shown on the main page, up to 500 characters (e.g., "A family-run yoga studio in Austin." or null).

about_body.description:
Full About text as HTML, shown on the About page. The server removes tags and attributes that are not on its allowlist before it stores the value (e.g., "

We opened in 2015.

" or null).

about_image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the About image (e.g., "https://res.cloudinary.com/livesite/image/upload/v1/LivesiteImages/about.jpg" or null).

cover_image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the cover image behind the page header (e.g., "https://res.cloudinary.com/livesite/image/upload/v1/LivesiteImages/cover.jpg" or null).

background_color.description: Page background colour as a 6-digit hex value. It shows when the page has no cover image and while the cover image loads (e.g., "#1f3a5f" or null).

action_background_color.description: Default background colour of the action buttons, as a 6-digit hex value (e.g., "#0c315e" or null).

action_text_color.description: Default text colour of the action buttons, as a 6-digit hex value (e.g., "#ffffff" or null).

custom_phone.description: Phone number that the page shows in place of the phone number of the business. Null: the page shows the phone number of the business. Whether a phone number is shown at all is a business setting, not part of this entity (e.g., "+1 512 555 0100" or null).

custom_email.description: Email address that the page shows in place of the email address of the business. Null: the page shows the email address of the business (e.g., "hello@example.com" or null).

custom_address.description: Address that the page shows in place of the address of the business. Null: the page shows the address of the business (e.g., "12 Main St, Austin, TX" or null).

location_city.description: City in the location line under the business name (e.g., "Austin" or null).

location_state.description: State or region in the location line under the business name (e.g., "TX" or null).

recommend_enabled.description: Whether the page shows the Recommend box with share links (e.g., true, false).

reviews_widget_enabled.description: Whether the page shows the reviews widget when the business has reviews publishing (e.g., true, false).

crawlable.description: Whether search engines may index the page. When false, the page asks search engines not to index it and the sitemap does not list it. A white-label business page is never indexed (e.g., true, false).

updated_at.description: The updated_at value that the client last read. When the stored value is newer, the request fails with 409 and nothing changes (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").

type.description: What the action does. It cannot change after the action is created. **schedule**: book an appointment or event. **pay**: make a payment. **package**: buy a package. **contact**: leave a message. **document**: upload a document. **call**: call a phone number. **googlemaps**: show a map. **youtube**, **vimeo**, **dailymotion**: play a video (new dailymotion actions cannot be created). **link**, **pdf**: open a URL in a new tab. **text**: show a text page. **facebook**, **twitter**, **instagram**: open a social profile (e.g., "schedule", "call").

title.description: Title shown on the action button, up to 255 characters (e.g., "Schedule now").

description.description: Text shown under the title (e.g., "Pick a time that suits you" or null).

position.description: Zero-based place of the action on the page. In an update, the action moves to this place and the server shifts the other actions (e.g., 0, 1, 2).

active.description: Whether the owner turned the action on. An inactive action is not shown on the page (e.g., true, false).

icon.description: Name of the design-system icon shown on the action (e.g., "calendar", "phone").

button_type.description: How the action is drawn. **button**: icon and title. **image**: an image above the button. **text**: a text block above the button (e.g., "button", "image").

image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the action image. Required when button_type is "image", except for video and map actions, which show a preview (e.g., "https://res.cloudinary.com/livesite/image/upload/v1/LivesiteImages/action.jpg" or null).

button_text.description:
HTML text shown when button_type is "text". The server removes tags that are not on its allowlist (e.g., "

Open every day

" or null).

use_brand_colors.description: Whether the action uses the default action colours of the page. When false, background_color and text_color apply (e.g., true, false).

background_color.description: Background colour of this action as a 6-digit hex value, used when use_brand_colors is false (e.g., "#b3261e" or null).

text_color.description: Text colour of this action as a 6-digit hex value, used when use_brand_colors is false (e.g., "#ffffff" or null).

options.description: Settings of the action. The allowed keys depend on type, and other keys are rejected. **schedule**: service_uid, category_uid, event_uid, staff_uid, date (all optional). **pay**: title, amount, currency (all optional). **package**: package_uid (optional). **contact**: title, message (optional). **document**: no keys. **call**: phone (optional; without it the action dials the phone number of the business). **googlemaps**: address (optional; without it the action uses the address of the business). **youtube**, **vimeo**, **dailymotion**: video_url (required). **link**, **pdf**: url (required). **text**: text (HTML; the server removes tags that are not on its allowlist). **facebook**, **twitter**, **instagram**: username (required) (e.g., {"service_uid": "srv8f3k2m1x9q7w5"}).
